newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end Tokyo down on stock rises, IRS payments - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end Tokyo down on stock rises, IRS payments - Sept 5.

text.p: Key December 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Thursday lower, hurt by steady advance of Tokyo share prices in the afternoon.

Another factor behind the fall was two- to four-year interest rate swap (IRS) payments by major Japanese banks, traders said. The payment was mainly aimed at taking profits from the recent fall in swap rates, they said.

"The recovery in Tokyo stocks was one thing and IRS payment was another thing hurting JGBs," said a city bank dealer. The December ended at 120.50, down 0.20 from Wednesday close, in turnover of 54,035 contracts.
